With rev'rence let the saints appear
With rev'rence let the saints appear,
His high commands with rev'rence hear,
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 89:7–52, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
With rev'rence let the saints appear, And bow before the Lord; His high commands with rev'rence hear, And tremble at his word. STANZA I
